statement: Nintendo output reports 0x01 and 0x10 contain separate four-byte left and four-byte right rumble words in the eight-byte payload even when addressing a single Joy-Con; the framing alone does not establish that either half can affect the other half.

applicability.revision: linux 4056b3c9d3c92ea45955641dbafeb9b960e146ef; SDL 535d80badefc83c5c527ec5748f2a20d6a9310fe; dekuNukem b354f21ae81f7b0d1d060b2b61e66ad0d9bc1756; no hardware
applicability.scope: Common subcommand and rumble format; source-only, no physical actuator characterization. Refer to swpro-l0-device-rumble-word-tables for shared encoding.
